On Wed, May 22, 2029 at 8:37 AM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben and Kimberly — can you advise on the entitlement mapping options for a private listing vs public catalog? Marcus — would you be able to prepare a short SLA draft we can attach (I started one and put it in the Drive link below).

Quick notes from entitlement/metering POV:
- Two primary flows we support:
  1) Private listing w/ delegated entitlement: CloudBridge passes a partner token; Redwood validates the partner token then maps to customer-owned entitlements (recommended for regulated accounts).
  2) Public catalog w/ sell-through: CloudBridge invoices/resells; metering reconciliation happens at the SKU level (requires periodic usage export & mutual ID mapping).
- Implementation impact: flow (1) needs an adapter endpoint to accept partner tokens + an entitlement lookup table (small metadata payload). Flow (2) needs a reporting API and a reconciliation cadence (monthly).
- Metering detail: to keep latency low we recommend SDK-level counting for token types with an occasional server-side reconciliation to handle dropped/failed requests.

Action items:
- Kimberly: can you confirm if CloudBridge prefers delegated tokens or reseller SKUs?
- Marcus: happy to review the SLA language once you push the draft.

Ben Carter\Partner Ops\Redwood Inference
